description: This file defines the NodeController class for managing admin menu nodes in an ASP.NET Core MVC application, including actions for listing, creating, editing, deleting, toggling, and moving menu nodes.

classes.name: NodeController
classes.description: Controller for managing admin menu nodes, including listing, creating, editing, deleting, toggling, and moving nodes.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Displays the list of menu nodes for a specified admin menu.

methods.name: BuildDisplayViewModel
methods.description: Builds the view model for displaying the admin menu nodes with thumbnails.

methods.name: Create (GET)
methods.description: Displays the form to create a new admin menu node.

methods.name: Create (POST)
methods.description: Handles submission of the new admin menu node creation.

methods.name: Edit (GET)
methods.description: Displays the form to edit an existing admin menu node.

methods.name: Edit (POST)
methods.description: Handles submission of the admin menu node edits.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified admin menu node.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.description: Toggles the enabled state of a specified admin menu node.

methods.name: MoveNode
methods.description: Moves a menu node to a new position within the menu.
